title: PendingApprovalChange
description: An approval-gated change held off an entity, as proposed by a single requester. The entity keeps serving its approved value; this is the proposed change awaiting commit or discard.

requester.description: User who proposed the held change (the entity `updatedBy` captured at edit time).

changeDescription.description: The held change as a change description diff: per gated field, `oldValue` is the approved value and `newValue` is the proposed value.
